name: Blackbeard’s Bounty

features.name: Cascading wins
features.description: Each win triggers a cascade, with a wild added after each one.

features.name: Doubling multiplier
features.description: The multiplier doubles with each cascade: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x and more.

features.name: Persistent bonus multiplier
features.description: In free spins the multiplier keeps growing until the round ends.

review:
A 243-ways pirate slot built around cascades. Every win sets off a chain, a wild drops in after each cascade to help it keep going, and the multiplier climbs each time: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x and up.

In free spins that multiplier never resets until the round ends – that's how this thing reaches its 20,000x max. Golden Bet boosts your bonus odds. Very high volatility, 96.2% RTP and free spins about once every 172 spins. When a cascade chain really gets going, it's great to watch.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
